chapter.heading: Psalm 11
The LORD Is in His Holy Temple
To the choirmaster. Of David.
chapter.v:
In the
LORD I,
take refuge; how can you say to my soul, Flee like a bird to your mountain,

if the
foundations are,
destroyed, what can the righteous do?(1)

The LORD
is in,
his holy temple; the LORD’s throne is in heaven; his eyes see, his eyelids test the children of man.

The LORD
tests the,
righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and the one who loves violence.

Let him
rain coals,
on the wicked; fire and sulfur and a scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

For the
LORD is,
righteous; he loves righteous deeds; the upright shall behold his face. Footnotes (1) 11:3 Or *for the foundations will be destroyed; what has the righteous done?* (ESV)
